DeployBot: scheduled rollout: API v2 -> staged rollout tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. plan: region-by-region (EU then US then APAC), initial canary 5% -> ramp to 100% over ~90m. change-id: CR-2026-0421. assigned: @Maya R @Jason H. ops playbook linked: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0421 :rocket:
Maya R: heads-up: we'll do EU first. mobile SDK still has ~1.0 clients we need to pin/filter. please confirm top mobile tenants and whether we can soft-pin them to v1 for 24h if needed.
Jason H: copy. can we get a quick client list? kira, can you run a query for clients reporting api-version header missing or "v1" in last 30d? example command: ```./tools/query_clients --since=30d --filter "api_version!=v2"```
Kira L: running now, small output. quick summary: ~42 tenants with >1% traffic on v1 in last 30d. top traffic hitters: acme-inc, beta-co, datazone. i can push a routing shim to treat missing header as v1 for 6h if we need to soften the spike. patch diff snippet: ```route_header_fallback: {"X-API-VERSION": "v1"}```
Lucas T: infra check: v2 autoscale pools warmed in eu-west and us-east (gpu pool: rwd-gpu-prod-3). kv-cache memory bump observed during last v2 alpha — recommend kv cache throttle flag set for initial ramp: `kv_throttle=true`. will preflight toggle before canary.
Ella (PM): release notes: add note about stricter message schema and that some older SDKs may omit new fields -> we should call out to enterprise contacts 48h pre-notice. i'll draft the blurb and send to comms.
Maya R: rollback / abort criteria proposal: - sustained 5xx > 0.3% for control plane for 5m OR - error rate increase >1% vs baseline for 10m OR - mobile crash reports spike >0.2% absolute. if any hit, hold and escalate to rollback. agree?
Jason H: agreed. i'll be ready to pause routing and kick rollback if needed. also: deploybot permissions check: who can initiate rollback? (i'll assume ops + release leads)
Nate - oncall: i'll be oncall for the window. if we need immediate rollback i can run `deploybot rollback CR-2026-0421` and post updates here.
DeployBot: canary started 02:10 UTC -> routing=5% (eu-west). telemetry hooks: /ops/telemetry/CR-2026-0421. monitoring dashboards live. :eyes:
DeployBot: canary telemetry alert: 5xx increased to 0.6% over last 4m (threshold 0.3%). alert id: A-CR-2026-01.
Maya R: holding rollout. please pause ramp and freeze traffic at current canary. @Jason H can you freeze at the routing layer?
Jason H: pausing ramp and pinning routing to 5% now. command: `routingctl set-split CR-2026-0421 5%` -> done.
Kira L: digging into logs: mobile user agent path shows header parse exception in SDK 1.0 when server returns the new `system_messages` schema. stacktrace sample: ```TypeError: cannot read property 'system' of undefined at parseSystemMessage (sdk.js:412)``` top affected tenants align with earlier list (acme-inc, beta-co).
Lucas T: infra mem/latency looks fine. no autoscale failures. kv-throttle already enabled preflight. this looks like a client-side parsing regression, not infra.
Maya R: decision: rollback v2 rollout. criteria met due to client crash signal + 5xx spike. @Jason H initiate rollback to 0% and open follow-up issue to coordinate SDK patch and a second attempt.
Jason H: initiating rollback... `deploybot rollback CR-2026-0421 --reason "client parsing crash + 5xx"`
DeployBot: rollback initiated by Jason H at 02:20 UTC. status: in-progress. rolling routing back to v1 defaults.
DeployBot: rollback completed 02:24 UTC. routing restored to 100% v1. change CR-2026-0421 marked: rolled-back. incident link: https://intra/redwood/incidents/CR-2026-0421-followup
Maya R: thanks. immediate next steps: 1) Kira to prioritize SDK 1.0 patch for header/system parsing and publish a compat patch, 2) Ella to send targeted 48h notice to top affected tenants, 3) Jason to prepare a guarded re-run plan with a smaller canary + extended client soft-pin window.
Kira L: will open PR for patch now and target a hotfix release.
Ella (PM): i'll draft and send comms in next 30m.
Jason H: i'll prepare a tighter ramp plan and gating telemetry for next attempt.
Nate - oncall: all good from oncall. i'll keep eyes on crash loops for next 24h. ping if you want me back in the channel during the relaunch.
Maya R: closing this thread for the rollback. follow-up doc: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0421-postmortem (WIP). thanks everyone :thumbsup:
